title: Setter-Based Setup and Takedown Clutter (Low-Abstraction Parameters)
pattern: A routine requires the caller to execute multiple setter methods in a precise order on a transaction object before executing the main process method, followed by a manual delete.
why_bad: Exposes internal object implementation details and enforces a temporal ordering of setters. If a caller misses any setter or calls them out of order, the process method runs on invalid data.
detection: Frequent occurrences of sequential `Set...` method calls immediately preceding a call to a processing routine that consumes the modified object.
counterexample: A Fluent Builder API where the object cannot be built or consumed until `.build()` is validated.
fix: Redesign the function interface to accept all required parameters directly as arguments (`ProcessWithdrawal(customerId, balance, amount, date)`).
